# DzFormField

Compound wrapper that provides form field context.

- **Family:** Forms
- **Source:** `packages/core/src/components/forms/DzFormField.vue` · types `packages/core/src/components/forms/DzFormField.types.ts`
- **Compound parts:** `DzFormDescription`, `DzFormLabel`, `DzFormMessage`

- **Entry points:** `@dzup-ui/core`, `@dzup-ui/core/forms`
- **Risk tier:** A · **Status:** stable

## Props (5)

| Prop | Type | Required | Declared default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | `false` | Whether the field is disabled |
| `error` | `string \| undefined` | no | `undefined` | Error message to display in DzFormMessage |
| `id` | `string \| undefined` | no | `undefined` | Custom ID prefix for the field and sub-parts |
| `invalid` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | `false` | Whether the field value is invalid |
| `required` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | `false` | Whether the field is required |

## Usage (from `packages/core/stories/forms/DzFormField.stories.ts`, story `Default`)

```vue

      <DzFormField v-bind="args" class="max-w-xs">
        <DzFormLabel>Country</DzFormLabel>
        <DzSelect :items="countryItems" placeholder="Select country..." />
        <DzFormDescription>Where you are primarily located.</DzFormDescription>
        <DzFormMessage />
      </DzFormField>
    
```
